bioschemas.name: RMVar
bioschemas.summary:
RMVar-Database of functional variants involved in RNA modification.



We collected millions of variants, as well as thousands of RNA modification sites from 28 miCLIP experiments, 2 PA-m6A-Seq experiments, 2 m6ACE-Seq experiments, 3 DART-Seq experiments, 7 m6A-REF-Seq experiments, 4 MAZTER-seq experiments, 2 m1A-quant-seq experiments, 2 m1A-IP-Seq experiments, 2 m1A-MAP experiments, 5 m7G-seq, 10 BS-Seq experiments, 2 Nm-Seq experiments, 14 RiboMeth-Seq experiments, 2 ψ-Seq experiments, 1 DM-ψ-Seq experiment, 3 Ceu-Seq experiments, 3 RBS-Seq experiments, 2 m6A-Seal-Seq experiments and 507 MeRIP-Seq experiments, together with a large number of predicted RNA modification sites are involved.
